text:
Ben: Passing Shipyard (shipyard.ai) to CS — quick context: they're on a 14-day trial, heavy API usage (embeddings + chat), asking for private VPC & HIPAA controls, and SSO. Main renewal risk: CFO wants clear cost/savings and an estimate for private deployment. Deal doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/SHIP-175 — adding thread for handoff.

Maya: Got it — Maya taking point for CS. Can someone drop the provisioning checklist + rough timeline? Also any immediate blockers for onboarding? :wave:

Ravi: Ravi (CS Eng) here. I can scope VPC + SSO work. Two blockers I see: 1) customer requests HSM/KMS integration (security signoff needed), 2) they want model pinned to rdl-2.1-quant — need confirmation this image is allowed for Private.

Priya: Priya (Solutions Eng): We validated rdl-2.1-quant perf in staging (small run), looks fine. For Private/Dedicated we need licensing confirmation from Legal. I can run a PoC on Dedicated if CS approves.

Ben: Contract team said legal is OK pending final pricing. Customer expects a 6-week PoC -> GA runway. Renewal risk escalates if we can't show predictable unit costs within 30 days.

Maya: Action plan: 1) Ravi scope infra & send estimate by Thu 2025-06-12. 2) Priya run PoC feasibility for Dedicated by Tue 2025-06-10. 3) Lena draft support runbook + SLAs. I'll handle customer comms and weekly updates.

Lena: Lena (Support): I'll draft the onboarding runbook and open a support ticket for provisioning. Creating SUPPORT-4321 now — will include required logs, curl examples, and escalation matrix.

Ravi: Infra notes for whoever implements: we need VPC peering + private endpoint + optional NAT for model downloads. Minimal config snippet to include in runbook:
```yaml
network:
  vpc_peering: true
  private_endpoint: shipyard-vpc
  region: us-east-1
```
Also need to confirm expected RPS so we size Dedicated pool.

Ben: They asked for us-east-1 initially, will confirm expected traffic and share numbers in deal doc.

Priya: For PoC I will provision a small Dedicated instance and run a 1k requests/min load test to capture token-cost and latency baseline. ETA Tue. I'll post results to the doc.

Maya: Thanks — @Lena when SUPPORT-4321 is ready ping me and I'll forward to the customer. @Ravi @Priya please update the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/shipyard-handbook with your estimates. I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Fri.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if this requires infra changes or private deployment, tag eng-oncall and submit an infra-change request (ICR).

Ben: Forwarding deal doc + CC'd CFO for transparency. Appreciate the quick turn. :thumbsup:
